title: Standards-Guided and Dependency-Aware Code-Level Documentation Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatically generating high-quality documentation for software repositories remains challenging: existing approaches largely treat documentation as unconstrained text generation, lacking explicit quality specifications, depending heavily on long-context prompts over raw code, and offering limited support for reproducible evaluation. We argue that code-level documentation generation should instead be a standards-guided software engineering task, in which documentation is generated and assessed against explicit, reusable quality requirements derived from authoritative standards. We define code documentation as natural-language descriptions of repository functions and classes, organized by source-code path. translated_title: 标准引导与依赖感知的代码级文档生成
translated_abstract: 为软件仓库自动生成高质量文档仍然具有挑战性：现有方法大多将文档视为无约束的文本生成任务，缺乏明确的质量规范，严重依赖对原始代码的长上下文提示，且对可复现评估的支持有限。我们认为，代码级文档生成应当是一项标准引导的软件工程任务，文档的生成与评估应基于从权威标准中提炼出的明确且可复用的质量要求。我们将代码文档定义为按源代码路径组织的、对仓库中函数和类的自然语言描述。我们提出了CODEDOC，一个标准引导且依赖感知的框架，该框架通过静态调用图和AST（抽象语法树）分析识别代码实体之间的依赖关系，并构建结合局部代码上下文的依赖感知结构化提示。
tldr: 提出CODEDOC框架，将代码级文档生成重塑为一项基于权威质量标准的标准引导软件工程任务，并借助静态调用图与AST分析构建依赖感知的结构化提示。
en_tdlr: Proposes CODEDOC, a framework that reframes code-level documentation generation as a standards-guided software engineering task, using static call-graph and AST analysis to build dependency-aware structured prompts.
